svnSectionHint: How the engine finds and runs the svn command-line client.

encodingHint: Encoding the engine assumes for command output.
logLimitHint: How many revisions the log panel loads per batch.

userHint: The credential svn would use for this working copy, when it knows one.

footer: SVN settings are shared across every working copy in this app.
